title: Group privacy
summary: Who can join a group, what older messages a new member sees, and the requests to join (bipe-chat/bipe#772). Opens from the row bipe_group_privacy_title in group-details, for members who can change the join rule.

join.description: Under bipe_group_privacy_join. invite: bipe_group_privacy_join_invite, JoinRule invite (the default of group-create). knock: bipe_group_privacy_join_knock, JoinRule knock. Another rule set by another client shows no choice selected.

history.description: Under bipe_group_privacy_history, with bipe_group_privacy_history_footer. joined: bipe_group_privacy_history_joined, RoomHistoryVisibility joined (default). shared: bipe_group_privacy_history_shared, RoomHistoryVisibility shared.

requests.description: Under bipe_group_requests, from Room.subscribeToKnockRequests. Hidden when empty. Each row has bipe_group_request_accept and bipe_group_request_decline when the member can invite.

setJoin.effect: Room.updateJoinRules. A failure shows bipe_error_generic and keeps the old choice.

accept.effect: KnockRequestActions.accept: the person is invited and can join.

notes: Encryption stays on and is not a choice (security rule 13).

Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#772): no "anyone with the link" choice and no room address, because under ADR 0179 join rule public makes a room plain text, and public rooms are the curated open groups of ADR 0182 (bipe-chat/bipe#749). mz can overrule.
A person with the group link (room-link-open) sees bipe_app_room_link_knock when the rule is knock.
